mapper.select: select id, ip, port, parent_id from nodes
mapper.insert: insert into nodes (ip, port, parent_id) values(#{ip}, #{port}, #{parentId})
mapper.delete: with recursive children as ( select id from nodes where id = #{id} union all select node.id from nodes node inner join children ch on node.parent_id = ch.id ) delete from nodes where id in (select id from children)
